verdicts.evidence: With VERIFY_FINDINGS = "" the lookup path collapses to the mission dir itself, so a mission with no findings file reports present:true/stale and check --strict prints "verify findings runward/ (2026-08-28) stale" instead of "no verify findings recorded yet". test/smoke.js reds on it (assertion "a green --strict names the verify-findings artifact it would surface", exit 1); smoke.js is outside the mutation runner's command, which runs only test/unit/*.test.js.
